messages:
mia: quick repro thread — found a bundler interop issue that only appears when packaging the SDK for edge runtimes (vite/rollup/webpack variations). It causes Authorization to be lost on retry attempts. sharing details and a small repro.

asher: ouch. does it only happen for ESM bundles?

mia: short summary: when the package resolves to the ESM export path, some bundlers inline a tiny helper that ends up reconstructing requests with `new Request(req)` instead of calling `req.clone()`. In our local edge shim that reconstruction can drop header iterables, so Authorization disappears on the retry. CJS builds (require path) still use `req.clone()` and work.

jonah: can you paste minimal reproduction steps?

mia: absolutely:
1) git clone https://example/repro-edge-interp
2) cd repro-edge-interp && npm ci
3) npm run build:edge:vite OR npm run build:edge:rollup (both generate dist/esm)
4) npm run serve:edge (local edge shim that mimics cloud edge fetch semantics)
5) curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer TEST_TOKEN\" http://localhost:8787/api/proxy

Observed: the proxied first request succeeds (200). The SDK performs a retry and the retry returns 401/403 because the Authorization header is missing.

mia: package.json in the repro uses exports to point at both entries:
```json
{"name":"repro-edge-interp","type":"module","exports":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.js","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"}}
```

mia: interestingly, when I inspect the built ESM output (dist/esm/edge-helper.js) the helper looks like this:
```js
function makeRetry(req){
  // injected by bundler/interop transform
  const clone = new Request(req.url, req); // ends up dropping headers in our shim
  return fetch(clone);
}
```

mia: while the CJS-built output contains the original clone call from our source: 
```js
function makeRetry(req){
  const clone = req.clone();
  return fetch(clone);
}
```

priya: what's the likely cause? plugin combo? specific to terser/rollup?

mia: local bisects point to a specific interaction: when @rollup/plugin-commonjs runs and then terser/tree-shake removes a tiny Request polyfill we ship, Rollup/Vite appear to inline a small helper that prefers `new Request(req)` to avoid depending on the polyfill. The end result depends on import/interop shape — e.g., default import vs `import * as SDK` can cause different helper shapes.

asher: can we force a change in SDK to avoid relying on bundler helpers?

mia: yes — I validated a defensive change that prefers `req.clone()` and falls back to an explicit header-preserving reconstruction when clone is not available. Example implementation I used in the repro:
```js
function safeCloneRequest(req){
  if (typeof req.clone === 'function') return req.clone();
  // fallback: copy headers explicitly to avoid losing auth
  const headers = new Headers();
  for (const [k, v] of (req.headers || [])) headers.set(k, v);
  return new Request(req.url, { method: req.method, headers, body: req.body });
}
```

mia: applying that change in the SDK and rebuilding the repro passes across Vite, Rollup, and Webpack edge bundles. It preserves Authorization on retries in our local edge shim.

jonah: any edge cases? streaming body, readable streams, keepalive?

mia: good call — this fallback does not preserve streaming semantics. In the repro I validated typical buffered request bodies (JSON POSTs) which are fine. Eng-runtime needs to review for true streaming, duplex body cases, and behavior on real cloud edge platforms. I added tests to cover JSON bodies and header iterability.

priya: what's next operationally?

mia: I opened a GH issue with repro, CI matrix, and a branch containing the patch and tests. Issue: \"edge bundles: retry helper may drop Authorization due to bundler interop\" — redwood/sdk#4472. Branch: devex/edge-safe-clone. CI matrix builds ESM for vite/rollup/webpack and runs the edge shim.

asher: can you link the repro in docs and add a temporary mitigation?

mia: already left a short note for support and docs: \"If you bundle for edge and see auth missing on SDK retries, try using namespace import `import * as SDK from 'redwood-sdk'` as a short-term mitigation or upgrade to SDK >= X.Y.Z when the patch lands.\" The namespace import sometimes forces a different interop path and avoids the inlined helper. Not perfect but helps a few customers immediately.

devx-bot: Issue created: redwood/sdk#4472 1 assigned to @jonah and @eng-runtime. CI queued for matrix builds. :white_check_mark:

jonah: i'll review the patch focusing on streaming bodies and whether we should detect and preserve body stream state. If it's safe, we'll merge and publish a minor patch.

priya: also add a short test to our SDK CI that builds with at least one edge bundler config (vite or rollup) to catch regressions like this earlier.

mia: done — CI job added to repro branch and a follow-up PR to the SDK repo's integration tests is ready.

asher: excellent. thanks for the clear repro and the temporary fix. Saved a support ticket for sure.

mia: thanks team — will follow up after eng-runtime review and the patch PR.
